method: provenance recovery from committed artifacts only (no numbers invented)
script_identification: v2_bias_audit.json keys {val_accuracy, best_epoch, flip_swap_corr, flip_swap_err, rotation_avg, blank_ns_rate, blank_cw_rate, cw_frac_spirals, brightness_agreement, n_train, n_val, training_data} match the results dict written by train_v2_fast.py exactly; checkpoint filename chirality_model_v2_best.pt matches the released HF model file.

93.7_percent.definition: best-epoch THREE-CLASS validation accuracy (CW/CCW/NOT_SPIRAL argmax) on the held-out random 80/20 split
93.7_percent.validation_augmentation: NONE — validation forward passes use the plain transformed tensors (X_val); the flip-equivariance loss and flip augmentation apply to training batches only (train_v2_fast.py validation block)
93.7_percent.early_stopping: patience 15 on best validation ACCURACY (not loss), per train_v2_fast.py

94.9_percent.definition: CW per-class validation accuracy on the same un-augmented validation split (CCW 91.3%, NOT_SPIRAL 99.4%), per BENCHMARK_REPORT.md section 4.1
94.9_percent.NOT: a post-hoc no-augmentation re-evaluation of the 3-class accuracy; no artifact supporting an aug/no-aug 93.7/94.9 pair exists in the committed tree or the released HF artifacts

prior_tex_claim_disposition: App B sentence 'Headline 93.7% three-class accuracy (with augmentation active); post-hoc evaluation without augmentation yields 94.9%' mis-attributed both numbers to augmentation state; corrected to the verified split/per-class semantics.
